Elderly Woman Dies After Being Struck by Vehicle

An 82-year-old woman has died from injuries sustained after being struck by a vehicle. The incident occurred when the woman was on the sidewalk and hit by a car. She passed away in the hospital the day after the collision. The location of the incident was Forest Hill, Toronto.
